mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM product p WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.seller_id != #{userId} AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT category_id FROM ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT category_id FROM browse_history bh JOIN product bp ON bh.product_id = bp.id WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bp.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT category_id FROM favorite f JOIN product fp ON f.product_id = fp.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.deleted = 0 ) t GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3 ) cat ) AND p.id NOT IN ( SELECT product_id FROM browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT product_id FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
